Title: Herald of Tophet + cards with anarch requirement

Messages.Author: Poci
Messages.Body:
Hello!

So my question would that if the Herald can or cannot use cards that require the sect anarch to play them, like 3-way cards.

Herald of Topheth

Demon

flight

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
VTES is a game about checking key words.

See Vivienne Géroux for example:
Cardtype: Ally
Cost: 1 pool
Unique ghoul with 2 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed. Requires an Anarch.
Vivienne can play cards requiring basic Celerity [cel] and/or Fortitude [for] as an Anarch vampire. Vampires you control get -1 stealth during political actions. A vampire you control can give another Methuselah control of Vivienne as a  action. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can steal Vivienne as a  action.

Thus the answer to Poci's question is "no".
